title: Dutch Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew inspired by Indian cuisine, made with tender pork and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
Cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomato, Dutch stew seasoning, and browned pork back to the pot.
Stir to combine and add the coconut milk and water.
Bring the stew to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the pork is tender, about 1.5 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
